name: Liberty Packaging
old_description: Liberty Packaging is a leading provider of innovative, sustainable packaging products and integrated supply chain solutions.
about:
Liberty Packaging operates from Omaha, Nebraska, as part of the Liberty Diversified International (LDI) family of companies. The business runs an integrated paper mill, Liberty Paper, in Becker, Minnesota, which feeds its packaging plants with 100-percent recycled fiber.

The company produces a range of corrugated packaging products — including partitions, dividers, bulk containers, graphic packaging, retail packaging, e-commerce packaging, and protective packaging — all made from recycled fiber certified to SFI, FSC, and PEFC standards. Its closed-loop recycling system reclaims used boxes to create new paper, and the mill’s location next to Xcel Energy allows reuse of emitted steam in the papermaking process. Beyond manufacturing, Liberty Packaging offers supply-chain services such as design and innovation, warehousing and distribution, kitting and assembly, and end-to-end support across locations in the United States and Mexico.

Liberty Packaging serves customers in sectors that require sustainable packaging and supply-chain solutions, including e-commerce, retail, consumer goods, and industrial markets. Its service models are customized for each client’s space and timing needs.

The company differentiates itself through its circular-economy approach: a fully integrated mill that controls raw material supply, third-party chain-of-custody certifications, and a strategic energy partnership that reduces environmental impact.

about:
Lieder Woodworking operates from Rogers, Minnesota, where it produces custom workbenches, retail desks, serving bars, and other modular freestanding furniture built exactly to client specifications. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders.

The shop works directly with customers to design and execute each piece, offering a collaborative process that covers design through fabrication. It describes its work as modular, freestanding furniture tailored to individual style and specifications. No facility size, headcount, or production volume figures are disclosed.

Its customer base includes both residential and commercial clients; a testimonial on the company’s site cites Tare Market as a business customer. The firm serves homeowners and businesses seeking custom wood furniture for homes or retail environments.

Lieder Woodworking emphasizes a hands-on, collaborative approach, stating that its passion lies in helping clients realize their vision down to the last detail. The company highlights its central Minnesota location for convenient pickup or delivery, and its commitment to craftsmanship, quality, and value.

name: Lifelines Neuro
old_description: EEG systems from Lifelines Neuro make neurodiagnostics accessible, reliable, and intuitive
about:
Lifelines Neuro is headquartered in Louisville, Kentucky, with additional offices in Woking, United Kingdom, and Dublin, Ireland. The company emerged as a pioneer in ambulatory EEG, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company designs and manufactures mobile, portable video EEG monitoring devices, including the Trackit amplifier series and the Trackit Solo video EEG system. Its cloud-based StratusEEG software enables 24/7/365 physician review of neurodiagnostic data from any device. Lifelines Neuro also provides turnkey clinical trial services with EEG protocol, continuing education on CPT reimbursement, and workflow consulting for service providers.

Lifelines Neuro serves hospitals and healthcare systems (including EMU, ICU, emergency department, and outpatient settings), clinical trial sponsors and contract research organizations, and in-home ambulatory EEG service providers such as EEG entrepreneurs and technologists launching new services.

The company's stated mission is to make neurodiagnostics accessible, reliable, and intuitive — summarized by its "We Imagine EEG Anywhere" tagline. It differentiates itself through HIPAA-ready secure systems, US-based customer support, and business tools that help service providers scale operations.

name: Lifetite Metal Products, LLC
old_description: LifeTite Metal Products is a manufacturer of premium metal roofing, metal siding and trim
about:
Lifetite Metal Products, LLC operates three roll-forming and fabrication facilities in Kenna, Belington, and Mt. Hope, West Virginia. Established in Kenna, the independently owned company has expanded to serve the broader region with premium metal roofing, siding, and trim components for residential, commercial, and agricultural markets.

The company’s core processes include custom fabrication and roll forming, supported by equipment such as a Thalmann Double Folder TD 200 and board-and-batten machines. Across its three West Virginia plants, Lifetite manufactures insulated metal building panels alongside standard roofing and siding profiles, offering a range of profiles for metal buildings.

Customers range from homeowners and local contractors to agricultural operators and commercial builders. The company serves the residential, commercial, and agriculture sectors directly, with testimonials noting next-day order readiness and a 72-hour turnaround on custom work.

Lifetite emphasizes material quality as the foundation of a durable roof, promoting benefits such as a 50-year lifespan, energy efficiency through reflective coatings, and recyclability. Its stated differentiators are premium products, fast service (72 hours or less), and custom fabrication to specification.

name: Lighthouse Woodworking
old_description: Established in 1995, we specialize in custom-built hardwood furniture. Our goal is to provide you
about:
Lighthouse Woodworking was founded in 1995 by craftsman Ron Light in Boyce, Virginia. The shop began as a one-man operation focused on custom-built hardwood furniture, emphasizing a personal relationship between maker and client.

The company produces heirloom-quality pieces including bookcases, armoires, blanket chests, tables, and chairs using solid walnut, cherry, ash, and tiger maple. Each item is hand-crafted with traditional joinery such as through-dovetails, mortise-and-tenon, and custom crown molding. Finishes are hand-applied, often using Danish oil, and hardware ranges from soft-close Blum slides to handmade brass pulls. The workshop handles design, milling, assembly, and finishing in-house.

Lighthouse serves residential customers across Virginia, Pennsylvania, and surrounding regions. Clients include homeowners in Falls Church, Winchester, Woodbridge, Clarke County, Woodville, Round Hill, and Paris, Virginia, as well as Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Projects range from single pieces like a pencil-post bed or Windsor chairs to whole-room systems such as a six-unit lighted shelf wall. The shop also restores and refinishes family heirlooms.

Light positions the business around a "custom furniture experience" where the client works directly with the craftsman from wood selection through final delivery. The company stresses affordably priced custom work, collaborative design, and attention to detail that ensures pieces become family heirlooms.

name: Lightspring Solar - North Dakota Solar Design & Install
old_description: Lightspring designed and installed the largest commercial rooftop solar system in Fargo, North Dakota
about:
Lightspring, LLC is a solar design and installation company based in Bismarck, North Dakota, with a statewide network of installers and energy auditors. Founded in January 2018 after a year of research by a group of local North Dakotans, the company was formed to "do solar right" in the region. The co-founders are North Dakota natives educated at the University of North Dakota and North Dakota State University, and the firm emphasizes keeping jobs and investment within the state.

The company provides turnkey solar photovoltaic, solar thermal, and battery storage systems for residential, commercial, and community-scale projects. Services include site assessment, custom design, permitting, interconnection, incentive and rebate filing (notably USDA Rural Energy for America Program grants), direct financing, installation, monitoring, and ongoing warranty support. Lightspring also offers solar air heating systems—selling 8TH FIRE solar thermal collectors—as a first step to reduce heating loads before adding PV. Over its first three years, the firm installed hundreds of kilowatts of solar PV and storage capacity.

Lightspring serves homeowners, businesses, farmers, tribal communities, and educational institutions across North Dakota and Minnesota. Notable projects include the largest commercial rooftop system in Fargo (on the PRx building), a solar PV installation at United Tribes Technical College, and community-scale solar farms on agricultural land. The company also conducts solar installer training programs to build a local workforce.

Lightspring differentiates itself through an "energy efficiency first" philosophy that reduces upfront solar costs by lowering consumption before sizing generation. Its three-step ethical solar approach—analyze efficiency, install solar thermal heating, then right-size PV—aims to deliver the most cost-effective clean energy. The firm operates a circular, community-led model, reinvesting locally and providing grant-writing expertise to help customers access federal incentives.

name: Limestone Cablevision
old_description: our Internet packages that feature unlimited data with all Internet services. $15 discount for Limestone Cable TV subscribers.
about:
Limestone and Bracken Cablevision has served the Ohio Valley region from its headquarters in Maysville, Kentucky since 1959. The company operates as a local cable television and broadband internet provider for residential and business customers across its service territory.

The company delivers cable television packages including high-definition DVR options with and without extended service plans, alongside Performance Broadband Internet featuring unlimited data on all tiers. Subscribers gain access to WatchTVeverywhere, a streaming platform that extends live and on-demand content to computers, tablets, and phones both inside and outside the home. Technical support is staffed by local technicians available 24 hours a day, with business offices open Monday through Friday.

Primary customers are households and businesses throughout the Ohio Valley area seeking bundled television and internet service. The provider offers a $15 monthly discount on internet for customers who also subscribe to cable TV, and promotes a no-contract policy across its internet plans.

The company emphasizes its longstanding local presence and direct-access support model as distinguishing factors, positioning itself as an alternative to national carriers by maintaining on-call technicians in the community it has served for over six decades.

name: Lindsey Medical Supply
old_description: How Lindsey Medical Supply is Changing Lives: Real Stories from Our Customers
about:
Lindsey Medical Supply operates two showrooms in the Oklahoma City metro area, with locations in Oklahoma City and Norman, Oklahoma. The business was founded by the Lindsey family and remains family-owned, though the exact founding year is not publicly disclosed. The company began as a local source for home medical equipment and supplies, aiming to help individuals and families maintain independence at home.

The retailer stocks a broad range of durable medical equipment, including power scooters, power and manual wheelchairs, rollators, walkers, canes, and over 50 lift chairs in various positions, fabrics, and sizes. It also carries respiratory and CPAP supplies such as CPAP machines, masks, nebulizers, and portable oxygen concentrators, along with hospital beds, mattresses, bed rails, and daily living aids like bath safety products, incontinence supplies, and wound care items. In-house technicians provide repair services for mobility equipment and lift chairs, and the company offers equipment rentals and insurance assistance.

Lindsey Medical Supply serves individuals and families across the Oklahoma City metropolitan area who need mobility solutions, respiratory equipment, and daily living aids. Its customers include seniors, people with disabilities, and caregivers seeking products for home recovery and long-term care. The company partners with manufacturers such as Pride Mobility, Golden Technologies, Invacare, ResMed, Inogen, and Bruno to supply branded equipment.

The company emphasizes local expertise, with staff who understand the specific needs of Oklahoma families, and a commitment to complete support from purchase through repair. Its differentiators include two physical showrooms for hands-on product trials, in-house repair capabilities, and a focus on helping customers find equipment that fits their lifestyle, home, and budget.

name: Liquid Blue Inc
old_description: Now you can stock yourselves with not one, but two legacy brands of homegrown tie-dye goodness.
about:
Based in Derry, New Hampshire, Liquid Blue Inc operates a wholesale business supplying two legacy tie‑dye apparel brands, Liquid Blue and The Mountain. The company acquired the assets of The Mountain tee‑shirt line, consolidating both brands under one distribution roof.

The company runs a password‑protected wholesale portal where approved retailers can place orders for both brands around the clock. Orders ship from a single location, simplifying logistics for buyers. Online orders receive a 5 % discount on the first purchase and 2 % on subsequent orders.

Its customers are primarily retail stores and specialty shops that carry graphic and tie‑dye tee shirts. The combined catalog spans the Liquid Blue and The Mountain design libraries, offering a range of eye‑catching patterns for the novelty and lifestyle apparel market.

The acquisition allows retailers to source both brands through a single account and shipment, reducing administrative overhead. Liquid Blue emphasizes the convenience of unified ordering and the heritage of two established tie‑dye labels.
